title: Deliver VTCRecordingStateEvent regardless of eventTypes
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[vtc] Deliver VTCRecordingStateEvent regardless of eventTypes
Spec (6024601): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md L168-170: "`VTCRecordingStateEvent` is the recording consent signal ({{JMAP-VTC}}), so the server delivers it for every call the subscription covers whether or not `eventTypes` lists it."
Code: crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/ephemeral.rs:193-195; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/ephemeral.rs:146-148
Now: should_deliver returns false for any event whose @type is not in filter.includes(), including VTCRecordingStateEvent.
Change: Skip the eventTypes check for VtcEvent::RecordingState. Keep the callIds and current-participant checks.
